_doc: One answer of GET /api/sync/pull?v=2. requested is the collection set of the round; position is first (scope set), middle, last (cursor set) or only (first and last). valid pages are what the server may send; the server never sends an invalid one (the Go harness refuses each for the reason given). A reader refuses an invalid page whole only when the fault is in the envelope; a case with level row has a bad row inside a good envelope: a reader decodes the page, skips that row as unreadable and keeps the rest (README, Reading rows; unreadable-rows.json). Row shapes: shapes (every key always present; library rows have deletedAt null when live, and a library tombstone is exactly libraryTombstone); typed rows decode as docs/contracts/study/rows.json. Typed rows here are copied from study/rows.json, library keys from library/rows.json shapes. Tokens are opaque: only the p2./c2. prefixes are a contract. Decoded by server/internal/sync (B2) and apps/web/src/lib/sync/pager.ts (the envelope) with apps/web/src/lib/sync/rows.ts (the rows). cacheControl is the Cache-Control of every v2 page (private, no-cache: never kept by a shared cache, revalidated, and saved by the web service worker for offline study, which skips answers that say no-store).
